name: Course Study Guide
description: Revision guide for a whole course from all its lectures: topics, key terms, what was emphasised, and practice questions.

sections.title: Course Overview
sections.instruction: In one paragraph, say what the course has covered so far, based on the lectures listed (oldest to newest).

sections.title: Topics by Lecture
sections.instruction: For each lecture, in date order, list its date and title and the main topics as short bullets.

sections.title: Key Terms
sections.instruction: List the important terms that come up across the lectures, each with a one-line definition as the lectures explain it.

sections.title: Emphasised for Exams and Assignments
sections.instruction: List everything the lectures say was stressed, will be examined, or is assessed, with the lecture date.

sections.title: Assignments and Deadlines
sections.instruction: List the assignments, readings and deadlines recorded, with due dates as recorded.

sections.title: Practice Questions
sections.instruction: Write 8 to 12 revision questions that cover the course, each followed by a short answer drawn only from the lectures.
